open.title: Open your account
open.invalid: This is not a valid address. Check it and try again.
open.noCamera: The camera could not be opened. You can paste the address instead.

payment.title: Did my payment arrive?
payment.placeholder: Paste the transaction code or an address
payment.notArrivedText: It did not go through. The money did not leave the sender's account; only the fee was taken.
payment.notYou: If your address is not in this list, this code did not pay you.
payment.more: This code may have more transfers than shown here. If your address is not in this list, we cannot tell from here whether this code paid you.
payment.notAPayment: This code is not a payment.
payment.failedNotAPayment: This code is not a payment, and it did not go through.
payment.notFound: We could not find this payment yet. If you just sent it, wait a minute and try again.

citizenship.title: Citizenship
citizenship.directorate: General Directorate of Population and Citizenship Affairs
citizenship.soonBody: This service will be available here soon.

network.title: Network
network.switchBody: The page reloads, and Pezkuwi Explorer then shows the network you chose. i-Wallet always stays on the mainnet.
network.switchSignOut: Your wallet is signed out first; connect it again afterwards.
network.switchFailed: This browser would not keep the choice, so the network was not changed.

state.error: This could not be loaded. Try again later.

cid.edit: Add a photo and name on this device
cid.localNote: The photo and name stay on this device only; they are never sent anywhere.
cid.notImage: This file is not a picture.
cid.notSaved: This browser will not keep them; they show only until you close the page.

walletModal.connectDesc: Connect your Pezkuwi.js extension to interact with PezkuwiChain
walletModal.extensionDesc: For desktop & laptop — install from Chrome Web Store
walletModal.mobileDesc: For mobile — scan QR code with pezWallet app
walletModal.afterInstall: After installing, refresh the page and try again
walletModal.wcInstallHint: Don't have pezWallet? Download it on Play Store.
walletModal.wcInstructions: Open pezWallet app → Settings → WalletConnect → Scan QR code
walletModal.wcTimeout: Connection timed out. Please try again.
walletModal.errAuthorize: Please authorize the connection in your Pezkuwi Wallet extension
walletModal.errNotFound: Pezkuwi Wallet extension not found. Please install from Chrome Web Store.
walletModal.errNoAccounts: No accounts found. Please create an account in Pezkuwi.js extension
walletModal.errExtensionTimeout: Extension connection timed out. Please check if the extension popup is blocked by your browser, then click Authorize and try again.

legal.accept: By continuing you accept the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.

warning.label: Warning
warning.title: Temporary service for iPhone users
warning.body1: This section exists to serve iPhone users until our app is published on the App Store. Hot wallets by nature do not offer high security: use it for your small transfers and citizenship tasks.
warning.body2: For large amounts and critical tasks, use the Pezkuwi Wallet app on an Android device, or wait for the App Store version.

create.title: Create your own wallet
create.body: Your key is stored only on this device, encrypted with your password; it is never sent to our servers.

import.cta: I already have a wallet · open with 12 words
import.title: Open with 12 or 24 words
import.body: Type the 12 or 24 backup words of your wallet, in order, separated by spaces.
import.label: 12 or 24 words
import.invalid: This is not a valid 12 or 24-word backup. Check the words and their order.
import.confirmTitle: Replace the wallet on this device?
import.confirmBody: This replaces the wallet on this device. Without the old wallet's 12 words you can never reach it again.

feature.balances: See your HEZ · PEZ · USDT balances

unavailable.title: Storage is unavailable in this browser
unavailable.body: i-Wallet keeps its encrypted key in this browser's storage, and this browser does not allow it (private mode or blocked site data). Open this page in a regular browser window, or use the Pezkuwi Wallet app.

home.title: Your i-Wallet
home.hot: Hot wallet · for small amounts and citizenship tasks
home.a2hs: If browser data is cleared your wallet goes with it: add this page to the Home Screen.

words.title: Your backup words
words.body: These 12 words are the wallet itself. If your phone is lost or Safari data is cleared, they are the only way to reopen your wallet.
words.warnTitle: Write them on paper, do not take a screenshot.
words.warnBody: Share them with no one; nobody, including us, will ever ask you for these words. If you lose them, nobody can recover them.
words.ack: I wrote the 12 words on paper

quiz.title: Verify your backup
quiz.body: Pick the three requested words by looking at what you wrote on paper. This step cannot be skipped: a wallet without a backup is a wallet doomed to be lost.

password.title: Set a password
password.body: The password opens your encrypted key on this device. If you forget it, you set the wallet up again with the 12 words.
password.label: Password

faceid.title: Open with Face ID
faceid.cancelled: Face ID was not set up, you can enable it later in Settings.
faceid.unavailable: Face ID is not available on this device.
faceid.storage: Face ID could not be saved on this device.

unlock.body: Type your password to open the wallet.
unlock.corrupt: The wallet data on this device cannot be read. Restore your wallet with your 12 words.

error.networkChanged: The Pezkuwi network has changed or did not answer as expected, so i-Wallet is not using it for now. Nothing can be sent until this is fixed; try again later.
error.notSaved: The wallet could NOT be saved on this device, so nothing was created. Try again, or use another browser window.

receive.title: Receive
receive.body: Show this address or let someone scan the code so they can send you HEZ, PEZ or USDT.
receive.warn: Send only Pezkuwi mainnet assets to this address.
receive.networks: This one address receives on all three Pezkuwi networks: Relay, Asset Hub and People.

settings.title: Wallet settings
settings.backupBody: Type your password to see the words. Do not show your screen to anyone.
settings.exportBody: Downloads the encrypted key file; you can import it into the Pezkuwi Wallet app later.
settings.deleteTitle: Delete the wallet from this device?
settings.deleteBody: This removes the wallet and its encrypted words from this device. The 12 words are the only way back; if you have not written them down you can never reach the wallet again.
settings.deleteFailed: The wallet could not be deleted. Try again.
settings.faceBody: Type your password to turn Face ID on.

send.title: Send {{token}}
send.invalid: This is not a valid address. Check the address and its checksum.
send.self: This is your own address. You can send, but the funds just stay with you.
send.feeFailed: The network fee could not be estimated.
send.exceeds: This is more than you can send.
send.noFee: The network fee is paid in HEZ and you do not have enough HEZ for it.
send.largeTitle: This amount is high for a hot wallet.
send.largeBody: For transfers above {{limit}} HEZ we recommend Pezkuwi Wallet on Android.
send.largeAck: I understand, I will send anyway
send.review: Confirm with Face ID or password
send.faceFailed: Face ID did not confirm. Type your password.
send.inBlock: Accepted by the network. Waiting for final confirmation…
send.dropped: The network did not accept the transaction. Nothing was sent.
send.interrupted: The connection dropped. The transfer may still go through: check your balance before sending again.
send.balanceFailed: Your balance could not be loaded.
send.otherNetwork: This address is for another network. Use a Pezkuwi mainnet address.
send.slow: Accepted by the network. Final confirmation is slow: it may still complete, check your balance later.

balances.InsufficientBalance: Insufficient balance. You do not have enough tokens for this transaction.
balances.ExistentialDeposit: The amount is too small: the account must keep a small minimum balance.
balances.Expendability: This would leave the account below the minimum balance. Send a little less.
balances.LiquidityRestrictions: Part of your balance is locked and cannot be sent.

assets.BalanceLow: Asset balance too low for this operation.
assets.NoAccount: The recipient has no account for this asset yet, and the amount is below the asset minimum.
assets.NoPermission: You do not have permission to perform this operation on this asset.
assets.Frozen: This asset is frozen for this account.
assets.BelowMinimum: The amount is below the minimum this asset allows.

identityKyc.ApplicationAlreadyExists: You already have a citizenship application. Please wait for approval.
identityKyc.ApplicationNotFound: No citizenship application was found for this account.
identityKyc.ReferrerNotCitizen: The referrer is not a citizen.
identityKyc.CannotApproveInCurrentState: This application cannot be approved in its current state.
identityKyc.CannotConfirmInCurrentState: This application cannot be confirmed in its current state.
identityKyc.NotTheReferrer: Only the referrer named in the application can do this.
identityKyc.IdentityHashAlreadyUsed: This identity data was already used for another application.
identityKyc.NotACitizen: This account is not a citizen.
identityKyc.CannotCancelInCurrentState: This application cannot be cancelled in its current state.

tiki.KycNotCompleted: Your citizenship application is not complete. Please complete it first.
tiki.UserAlreadyHasRole: This account already has this role.
tiki.CitizenNftAlreadyExists: This account already has a citizen NFT.
tiki.CitizenNftNotFound: No citizen NFT was found for this account.

pezkuwiXcm.LocalExecutionIncompleteWithError: The HEZ could not be moved: usually there is not enough HEZ on Asset Hub. Nothing was moved.
pezkuwiXcm.FeesNotMet: There is not enough HEZ to pay the transfer fees.
pezkuwiXcm.Filtered: The network does not allow this transfer right now.

citizen.title: Citizenship
citizen.intro: Apply for citizenship of Digital Kurdistan. A citizen who knows you vouches for you, then you confirm and receive your Welati Tiki NFT.
citizen.loadFailed: Your citizenship status could not be loaded.
citizen.interrupted: The connection dropped. It may still go through: check this page again in a minute before trying again.
citizen.approvedNoNft: Your citizenship is approved, but no citizen NFT was found for this account yet.

fund.title: Move HEZ to the citizenship chain
fund.body: Applying needs {{need}} on the citizenship chain (People); you have {{have}} there. Move {{amount}} from your main HEZ balance (Asset Hub).
fund.noHez: Not enough HEZ on Asset Hub: you need {{need}} and have {{have}}.
fund.waiting: Waiting for the HEZ to arrive on the citizenship chain…
fund.late: The HEZ has not arrived yet. Check again in a minute.

form.referrerInvalid: This is not a valid address. Check the address and its checksum.
form.referrerNote: If you were invited by another citizen, enter their address. If empty, you will be linked to the Founder (Satoshi Qazi Muhammed).
form.privacy: Your personal data stays in this browser only. The chain records only a one-way code made from it; your data cannot be read back from that code.
form.notSaved: This browser would not keep your form, so it is not saved on this device.
form.agree: I understand that my data stays on this device and that the chain records only a one-way code made from it, which cannot be turned back into my data

deposit.title: {{amount}} deposit required
deposit.body: A deposit of {{amount}} is reserved when you submit your application. It is returned if you cancel your application.

pending.title: Waiting for your referrer's approval
pending.body: Your application has been submitted. Your referrer needs to vouch for your identity before you can proceed.
pending.depositBack: Deposit will be returned if you cancel

approved.title: Your referrer approved
approved.body: Your signature is needed to complete your citizenship.

refs.title: Wallets you referred
refs.body: These people named you as their referrer. Approve only someone you know.
refs.failed: The wallets you referred could not be loaded.
refs.empty: You have not referred anyone yet.
refs.how: To refer someone, share your address or the link below. When someone names you as referrer in their citizenship application, it shows here and waits for your approval.

state.signing: You approved · waiting for their signature

act.teleport: Move HEZ to the citizenship chain

install.title: Add i-Wallet to your Home Screen
install.step1: Tap the Share button in your browser's toolbar
install.iosNote: The Home Screen app keeps its own storage, separate from Safari: open i-Wallet from the Home Screen. If you created your wallet in Safari, restore it there with your 12 words.
install.landing: First add i-Wallet to your Home Screen and create your wallet there
install.landingQuick: Add i-Wallet to your Home Screen for quick access
